chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
He said: The most beloved of deeds to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is that which the servant persists upon, even if it be little.

key_terms.إِنْ قَلَّ: Even if it is little / small in quantity

ai.seo_question: What makes a small deed beloved to God according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) highlights that consistency (istiqarah) transforms minor deeds into significant spiritual achievements, preventing the stagnation of faith. It serves as a practical guideline for believers to maintain a sustainable spiritual routine rather than striving for occasional, exhausting bursts of worship. This principle underscores the divine preference for steady, enduring devotion over sporadic intensity.
